approved_scope: For the countable discrete restricted wreath product W=Z wr Z, a dense G_delta subset of the FULL Polish space of continuous W-actions on Cantor space has hyperfinite orbit relation on the ENTIRE Cantor space. More generally every Borel W-action on a standard Borel space admitting an ACTUAL Borel shift-equivariant map p:X->Zhat has hyperfinite orbit relation on all X. Fixed-width slab dimensions may grow with width; slab classes need not be finite.
